label: Week 3
method: Saturday rollup of nightly search_news + counts; items already filter-passed; no invented nights
headline: Week 3’s loudest room was Green Bay: Packers O-line crisis talk and the Jets OT hangover gave way to Thursday’s 35-14 Falcons blowout at Lambeau. Philadelphia’s Titans leftovers plus the Bears Monday board, Dallas’s Commanders fallout and Brazil injury chatter, and New Orleans’s Ravens win / Raiders Week 3 noise filled the next tier. Cleveland’s Chubb retirement day and Watson win chatter, Chicago’s Caleb Williams hamstring crisis, Las Vegas’s 2-0 Bowers-less start, Kansas City’s Colts OT thriller and Walker explosion, and Atlanta’s Penix debut then Lambeau stunner rounded out the sticky rooms. All seven nights logged. Quiet clubs stayed quiet. Vibe only.
